title: Baon
setup: Tanghalian na. Si Rico, ang kaklaseng laging maaga, ay walang baon — nakalimutan daw ng nanay niya. May sobra kang tinapay at itlog. Tumingin siya sa pagkain mo, tapos sa'yo.
setup_en: It's lunchtime. Rico, the classmate who always arrives early, has no baon — he forgot, his mother said. You have extra bread and egg. He looks at your food, then at you.

success.text: Natawanan ni Rico. Magkasama kayong kumain.
success.text_en: Rico laughs with relief. You eat together.

fail.text: Nahiya siya, pero natulungan mo pa rin siya.
fail.text_en: He's embarrassed, but you still helped him.

success.text: Napasaya mo siya nang walang pang-iinsulto.
success.text_en: You cheer him up without embarrassing him.

fail.text: 'Ayaw ko ng palit,' sabi ni Rico. Mababang loob siya.
fail.text_en: 'I don't want a trade,' Rico says. He's proud.
